title: Longer reinforcement learning for the confirmed discovery controllers
description: The confirmed controllers (experiments/controller-rl-confirm.json, release exp-controller-rl-confirm-31) at each teacher's setting continue by PPO for 240 more iterations, from the actor and value network each run left (init_from): Cubic at learning rate 0.0003, clip 0.2, noise 0.2; BBRv3 at learning rate 0.00003, clip 0.2, noise 0.1; widths 7, 10 and 16 and the reference without an encoder (k 0), seeds 1 to 3: 24 runs, 360 iterations in all. The owner's decision: push the log utility up first; controllers are not compared with each other and the share of a competing flow is not judged until they train well, and fairness is left to ccperf afterwards (docs/methodology.md, comparing controllers). At 120 iterations no controller reached the fixed rule (the references ended 0.11 and 0.16 below it) and the scores still rose by 0.02 to 0.03 on average over the last 20 iterations, up to 0.13 in single runs. Everything else is as in the confirmation: 8 links with 4 rollouts each per iteration, 30 s episodes, noise held for 20 steps, reward horizon 1 s, the first 3 iterations update the value network alone, no anchor to the start, stopping at 4 h (the policy a run leaves is scored either way). Evaluation: before training, every 20 iterations and for the policy the run leaves, without noise on the 21 validation links under 6 conditions; each evaluation now keeps every link and condition. What is read: each run's score against the fixed rule over all conditions, with and without a competing flow, against its score at 120 iterations; whether the curve still rises at the end; per teacher and width the mean and spread over seeds. Nothing is chosen from this run. The test links are not read.
run: case "$TEACHER" in cubic) LR=0.0003; CLIP=0.2; NOISE=0.2;; bbr3) LR=0.00003; CLIP=0.2; NOISE=0.1;; *) exit 2;; esac; R="ctl-$TEACHER-k$K-s$SEED"; T="$R-lr$LR-c$CLIP-n$NOISE"; S="$OUT/spec-$T.json"; jq --arg from "$IN/runs/$T" --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson clip "$CLIP" --argjson noise "$NOISE" '.algo = "ppo" | .init_from = $from | .inputs = "raw" | (if $k > 0 then .latents = $k | .action_max = 8 else . end) | .share_k = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .critic_warmup = 3 | .noise_sigma = $noise | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = $lr | .clip = $clip | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 240 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 14400' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/$T" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
collect: uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/ctl-*; uv run python experiments/settings_search.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/ctl-*; cat "$OUT/settings-search.md" "$OUT/summary.md" > "$OUT/both.md"; mv "$OUT/both.md" "$OUT/summary.md"
